title: Fix misleading 'Keeps alive' doc comment on streakMilestoneAnalyticsObserverProvider — it is declared autoDispose

evidence.quote: /// Keeps alive to monitor streak milestones for the active profile.

why: In a codebase where SM-6 gives `keepAlive: true` a specific, load-bearing meaning ('every keepAlive: true carries inline justification'), a doc comment reading 'Keeps alive' directly above a provider declared `.autoDispose` reads as a factual claim about Riverpod lifecycle rather than a plain-English aside — a maintainer skimming the doc before touching this provider's lifetime semantics is one likely misreading away from a wrong conclusion about whether it's safe to change.
recommendation: Reword to something like 'Stays active while watched to monitor...', removing the collision with Riverpod's keepAlive terminology.
acceptance_criteria: Doc comment no longer contains the phrase 'Keeps alive' unless the provider is actually annotated keepAlive: true

corrections: Quote 'Keeps alive to monitor streak milestones...' is at line 20, not the cited line 2 (line 2 is actually '/// [AnalyticsEvent.streakMilestoneReached] the first time the'). Second citation (line 39, autoDispose) is exact.
